construct: MHC class II molecules leave the ER associated with invariant chain. After invariant-chain degradation in endosomal compartments, CLIP remains in the peptide-binding groove until HLA-DM facilitates CLIP removal and loading of exogenous antigenic peptides.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: HLA-DM acts in the MHC-II loading compartment to release CLIP from the peptide-binding groove and facilitate loading/editing of endosomally derived peptides.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: TAP, tapasin, beta2-microglobulin and calnexin are MHC-I pathway components or chaperones. HLA-DM uniquely facilitates CLIP removal from MHC class II.
